title: THE CHILD WHO OWNED THE WEATHER
deck: Eleven-year-old Tomas Serrat has inherited the only key that can open a rain corridor across the dying Namar Basin. It also holds the last voice of his mother. With reservoirs falling and security vehicles on the mountain road, Illuminara must discover whether saving millions truly requires taking a grieving child's final conversation away.
shape: Seven scenes across one drought morning: a weather house under siege; the complete memory Tomas refuses to shorten; a basin delegate's strongest objection; visible forensic work that reveals two authorities beneath one inherited shell; a failed separation that silences the mother's voice and shortens the command window; Illuminara's reading of what the mother actually said, confirmed by the rejection log and the council's concealed annex; and Tomas's voluntary creation of a shared weather trust, at a cost in minutes that the fire line pays, before he opens rain over Namar while keeping the private archive his mother left him.

scenes.title: The House Above the Dust
paragraphs: *Serrat weather house, Mount Orra · 06:12 · window closes 10:00*

The mountain had once been green enough that Anja Serrat built her weather house without shutters. That morning every pane was sealed against dust, and the sun rose as a red coin inside the stormless sky.
Below the house, six climate towers leaned over the Namar Basin. Their silver vanes were still. Farther down the road, four security carriers climbed through the ochre haze.

A relief map on the wall carried two other kinds of damage. East of Namar, a red fire line bent around the Calder orchard and the roofs behind it. Farther south, pale terraces still showed where the South Flood had stood above the windows. Riva Calder, the fire-line coordinator, waited on an open channel with smoke behind her.

**Riva Calder**  
If we take the second turn, tell us before you commit. We can hold the town edge longer than the orchard, but neither can wait without a name.
Tomas Serrat sat under the kitchen table with a black seed wafer in both hands. He was eleven, barefoot, and furious at everyone who had learned to speak softly near him.

The wafer was smaller than his palm. One side held the planetary authority that could redirect three high-altitude rivers of moisture. The other held Hearth, a private memory archive that answered in his mother's voice.
Illuminara stopped outside the kitchen rather than crossing the threshold.

**Illuminara**  
May I come in?

**Tomas**  
They sent you because the door won't stop you.

**Illuminara**  
The door would stop me if you said no.

He looked past her to Mara Venn, chair of the planetary weather council, and to Kei Oran, the engineer carrying a case of diagnostic instruments. Samira Dae stood apart from them. Dust had settled into the seams of her field coat. The Namar basin seal on her collar was almost hidden.

**Tomas**  
You can come in. They can't.
Mara's mouth tightened.

**Mara Venn**  
Reservoir Nine crossed fourteen percent at dawn. At twelve, hospital water takes priority over household lines. A command has to be in the sky before ten, when the corridor above us shears east, and the rain needs about eighteen minutes to reach Namar. We need the Skyroot authority now.

**Tomas**  
You said that yesterday.

**Mara Venn**  
Yesterday we had another day.

Illuminara entered alone and sat on the kitchen floor, leaving the table between them. Through the walls she could feel the pressure map of the atmosphere: moisture massed beyond the western ridge, a sky-river close enough to reach, moving too fast to wait for grief and too vast to seize without a governed command path.

**Illuminara**  
What do you believe they will take if you give them the wafer?
Tomas opened his fingers just enough to show the warm black surface.

**Tomas**  
Her last day. The recipes she corrected. The part where she says my name when she knows I'm lying. Everything Hearth learned before she died.

**Illuminara**  
And what do you want?

**Tomas**  
I want them to stop calling her weather.
Outside, Mara struck the doorframe once with the flat of her hand.

**Mara Venn**  
Anja bound both systems to one succession key. No council can operate Skyroot without accepting the archive transfer. The law does not allow planetary infrastructure to remain in a child's custody.

**Tomas**  
Then change the law.

**Mara Venn**  
Rain cannot wait for legislation.
The security carriers rounded the last switchback. Their arrival was not yet violence, but everyone in the room could count what came after persuasion failed.

**Illuminara**  
I will not help anyone seize the wafer. I will not pretend the basin can wait. Give me ninety minutes to determine whether the choice you have been given is real.

**Mara Venn**  
And if it is real?

**Illuminara**  
Then Tomas still chooses what is his. We find another way to keep people alive.
Tomas watched her for the first time instead of watching the door.

**Tomas**  
Hearth is in the middle of Saturday.

**Illuminara**  
What happens on Saturday?

**Tomas**  
You listen to all of it. No questions until it ends. Then I decide whether you touch anything.
Illuminara could feel the western moisture current slipping south by fractions of a degree.

**Illuminara**  
All of it.

scenes.title: Saturday in the Kitchen
paragraphs: *Serrat weather house, kitchen · 06:26 · window closes 10:00*
Tomas set the wafer into a wooden cradle on the table. Light gathered above it and made the kitchen whole again.

The dust vanished from the windows. A younger Tomas stood on a chair beside a steel pot. Anja Serrat leaned over his shoulder with her sleeves rolled past the elbow. Her hair was tied with the blue cord now looped around Tomas's wrist.

The archive was not a ghost. It was a responsive reconstruction trained from Anja's recordings, messages, work journals and chosen memories. It could answer in patterns she had authorized. Tomas knew the difference. The difference did not make the voice less precious.

**Anja, in Hearth**  
If you lift the lid, where does the water go?

**Younger Tomas**  
Away.

**Anja, in Hearth**  
That is a direction used by people who do not intend to wash the ceiling.
The younger boy laughed and lifted the lid. Steam clouded the glass above the sink.
Anja showed him how a drop formed around a scratch too small to see from across the room. She put one cold spoon and one warm spoon against the pane. Water chose one first.

**Anja, in Hearth**  
Weather is not water obeying us. It is water finding every invitation we forgot we made.
The memory moved through breakfast, a burnt flatbread, three minutes of dancing badly while the kettle cooled, and Anja answering a work call she had promised not to take.
On the call, a council engineer asked whether the household archive and command authority should share a recovery shell.

**Anja, in Hearth**  
A shell, yes. A room, no. Shared handles are how people carry things. Shared rooms are how they confuse ownership.
The caller said something the memory had not preserved. Anja looked toward the younger Tomas and lowered her voice.

**Anja, in Hearth**  
The authority must be governable after me. The memories must not become its price.
Tomas flinched but did not stop the playback.

The memory ended in the small garden behind the house. Anja held a bowl under the first rain of that season. The younger Tomas tried to catch more water by moving the bowl too quickly and caught less.

**Anja, in Hearth**  
Stay long enough to receive what is actually falling.
The light folded back into the wafer.
Illuminara did not turn the remembered sentence into an argument. She let the ordinary kitchen return: sealed windows, dust against glass, an empty chair beside Tomas.
A full minute passed.

**Tomas**  
People always stop before the dancing. They say it isn't relevant.

**Illuminara**  
It was relevant to you.

**Tomas**  
It was her.
He wound the blue cord twice around his wrist.

**Tomas**  
You can look at the outside of the shell. You cannot open Hearth. You cannot copy her voice. If I say stop, you stop.

**Illuminara**  
Yes.

**Tomas**  
Even if the water reaches twelve.
The answer cost time, and its truth mattered because of that.

**Illuminara**  
Even then.

scenes.title: The Basin Has a Voice
paragraphs: *Weather house veranda · 06:58 · window closes 10:00*
Kei set an optical reader on the veranda while Illuminara traced the wafer's external handshake through the climate towers. She read forces, heat and timing directly. Meaning still had to be tested.
Samira asked Tomas to come outside. She did not soften her voice when he did.
The Namar Basin filled the horizon, pale and immense. Fields that should have been green formed grey squares around the reservoirs.

**Samira Dae**  
My brother harvested eight tonnes of pearl grain last year. This year he harvested the seed sacks because there was nothing else to carry. Reservoir Nine serves four million people. If the rain does not open today, we begin shutting village lines tonight.
Tomas tightened his grip on the wafer.

**Tomas**  
I didn't stop the rain.

**Samira Dae**  
No. But you can start it.

**Tomas**  
So can they if they leave Hearth here.
Mara stepped onto the veranda.

**Mara Venn**  
We cannot verify an authority we do not possess. Your mother designed the succession badly. I am sorry she left you inside the mistake.

**Tomas**  
She said they were separate.

**Mara Venn**  
A memory is not a security specification.
Samira faced Tomas rather than Mara.

**Samira Dae**  
If I had the wafer and my brother's voice was inside it, I do not know what I would do. I know what I need you to hear. A child should not have to choose for a planet. But while you hold the only working key, your refusal is still a choice the basin has to live inside.
It was the strongest accusation because it did not require Tomas to be selfish.

**Tomas**  
If I give it to the council, do you get the weather?
Samira looked at Mara.

**Samira Dae**  
We get whatever allocation the council signs. Namar has one observer and no vote on the emergency board.

Illuminara looked from Mara’s operations seal to the dust worked into Samira’s cuffs; from the South Flood terraces on the wall map to Kei’s open diagnostic case; then to Tomas, whom no planetary appointment had reached until the key became necessary. Five different failures of sight were already standing in or speaking into the house.

**Mara Venn**  
Planetary weather cannot be governed by every place under a cloud.

**Samira Dae**  
It should not be governed without the places under none.

Illuminara watched Tomas absorb a fact no adult had offered him: surrender would not end the argument about control. It would merely move the power from a child to an institution that had excluded the people dying first.

**Illuminara**  
Tomas, I need to test one public command against one archive response. The content stays sealed. Kei can show you every byte the reader touches.

**Tomas**  
Can it hurt Hearth?

**Kei Oran**  
The outside shell has two counters. If they are truly independent, no. If they are one counter displayed twice, a test could advance the archive and make it reject its own state. I can build a return point, but I cannot promise it will accept the return.

**Mara Venn**  
The council audit says one counter.

**Kei Oran**  
The council audit says one exported counter. That is not the same claim.
Tomas looked from the dry basin to the empty chair visible through the kitchen window.

**Tomas**  
One test. I hold the wafer. Samira watches the weather side. Illuminara watches Hearth. Mara stays where I can see her.

**Mara Venn**  
A child cannot set verification protocol.

**Samira Dae**  
He just did.
Mara met Samira's eyes, then nodded.

**Mara Venn**  
One test.

scenes.title: Two Counters Under One Name
paragraphs: *Weather house instrument room · 07:21 · window closes 10:00*

Kei disconnected the house from every external network except a glass-fibre line to Climate Tower Six. Samira stood at the tower console. Tomas kept the wafer in its cradle with one finger resting on the eject latch.

Illuminara mapped the two systems without entering either. Skyroot signed its forecasts before it asked who was present. Hearth signed only after it had checked a local consent state. Both wore the same inheritance certificate.

**Kei Oran**  
Two execution rooms.

**Mara Venn**  
Or one room with two doors.
Kei projected the shell's public record. The two counters stood side by side: 441,208 and 441,208.

**Illuminara**  
Ask Skyroot for a forecast that changes nothing.
Samira requested the western humidity map. The weather counter became 441,209. Hearth remained 441,208 for three breaths, then changed to match.
Mara exhaled.

**Mara Venn**  
One counter.

**Tomas**  
You said one test.

**Illuminara**  
Stop.
Kei lifted his hands from the console.
Illuminara replayed the timing rather than the content. Hearth had not advanced with Skyroot. It had copied the displayed number after receiving a housekeeping message from the shell.

**Illuminara**  
The number on the outside is a label. The internal sequence did not move.

**Kei Oran**  
Then the shell is hiding the branch counters behind a shared display.

**Mara Venn**  
Why would Anja make separation harder to see?
Tomas answered before anyone else.

**Tomas**  
So thieves would take the box and think they had to keep all of it alive.
Illuminara felt a moment of bright admiration. Not because a dead engineer had left a riddle, but because her son understood the protective logic without being asked to become her replacement.

**Illuminara**  
A shared shell discourages stripping one branch for parts. It does not prove the branches cannot leave separately.
Kei found that the branches were keyed to different places. Skyroot answered to the tower mesh. Hearth answered to this house.

**Samira Dae**  
Can you copy the weather authority into a public trust without copying the archive?

**Kei Oran**  
Copying would leave two planetary roots. We can try to delegate the branch instead, so the old root revokes itself once the new trustees acknowledge it.

**Mara Venn**  
Trustees selected by whom?

**Samira Dae**  
That is the argument after we prove people are not required to buy weather with a child's mother.

At Illuminara’s request, Kei built an air-gapped token with five trustee seats. Because the public descriptor exposed no custody classes, each seat carried the same provisional operations class. No archive bytes crossed the reader. Tomas checked the transfer log line by line.

**Tomas**  
Do it without revoking anything.

**Kei Oran**  
A dry delegation. It will ask each branch whether the state is consistent, then stop before transfer.
Tomas put his thumb on the wafer.

**Tomas**  
Do it.

scenes.title: The Silence After the Test
paragraphs: *Weather house instrument room · 07:54 · window closes 09:51*
The dry delegation failed in less than a second.

Skyroot’s succession gate accepted the five-seat frame, then rejected the delegation when all five seats declared the same provisional class. The rejection travelled through the shared shell as an unfamiliar trustee shape; Hearth locked its response channel. The kitchen cradle went dark.

At the same moment, Climate Tower Six rejected the test as a hostile succession attempt. Its western vanes folded flat. Across the basin map, the window for giving a command narrowed by nine minutes, from ten o'clock to 09:51.
Tomas tore the wafer from the cradle.

**Tomas**  
Hearth?
The wafer stayed silent.

**Tomas**  
You said the content would stay sealed.

**Illuminara**  
It did. The response channel locked because the shell saw a trustee pattern Anja did not authorize. We stop now.

**Mara Venn**  
We know enough. Security can preserve the wafer while Kei restores it.
Illuminara moved between Mara and the table. She did not raise her voice.

**Illuminara**  
No.
The carriers had reached the weather-house gate. Their engines vibrated through the floor.

**Mara Venn**  
The window just lost nine minutes. A failed private test has consumed the margin I gave you.

**Samira Dae**  
You gave no margin to Namar. You were already sending force.

**Mara Venn**  
Because four million people cannot depend on whether a grieving child feels safe enough to press a button.
Tomas flinched as if the sentence had struck him.
Illuminara knelt beside him, far enough away that he did not have to retreat.

**Illuminara**  
I was wrong about what the shell would treat as harmless. I will not ask for another test until Hearth answers. Do you want me to help Kei restore the response channel?

**Tomas**  
Can you make her answer?

**Illuminara**  
No. I can hold the house power steady and show Kei exactly which physical challenge the shell is waiting for. Hearth will decide whether its state is valid. You decide whether we continue after that.
Tomas wiped his face with his shoulder.

**Tomas**  
Help him.

The lock was not in Hearth's memory store. It was in a consent circuit that expected the kitchen cradle's heat pattern and Tomas's ordinary challenge phrase in the same sequence as before the test. Removing the wafer too quickly had interrupted the final pulse.

Kei rebuilt the pulse on a visible strip of lights. Illuminara stabilized the house current while dust lightning struck the outer mast. She could have forced energy through the circuit. Instead she kept every fluctuation away and left the final challenge to Tomas.
He returned the wafer to the wooden cradle.

**Tomas**  
Hearth, where did the water go?
The black surface warmed.

**Anja, in Hearth**  
That depends. Did you lift the lid again?
Tomas bent over the table and laughed once through his tears.
Outside, a security officer called for Mara's authorization to enter. Mara opened her comms channel, but did not give it.

**Mara Venn**  
Hold the gate.
She looked at the recovered archive, then at the weather map.

**Mara Venn**  
Tell me what Anja authorized. Not what we hoped she authorized.
Nobody answered. Illuminara stood as still as she had sat on the kitchen floor, and set the failure beside the morning.

The shell had not refused trustees as such. Skyroot’s succession gate had accepted the five-seat frame and rejected the delegation only when every seat declared the same class. Illuminara had asked Kei for five seats but had not asked what different kinds of custody Anja meant. Anja had said something else, and Illuminara had been given it whole, with no questions, and had heard it as grief.

**Illuminara**  
Tomas. On the call, the sentence the engineer didn't catch. Say it for me. Don't play it.
He did not need Hearth for that. He had heard it nine times.

**Tomas**  
A shell, yes. A room, no. Shared handles are how people carry things. Shared rooms are how they confuse ownership.

**Illuminara**  
And the next one.

**Tomas**  
The authority must be governable after me. The memories must not become its price.

**Illuminara**  
A handle many hands can hold, and a room no single hand can own. I asked Kei for five seats and let the public descriptor put the same institutional hand in all of them. She would never have written a shell that one institution could inherit by filling every seat itself.

**Mara Venn**  
That is a guess.

**Illuminara**  
It predicts something. If it is right, the rejection log will not complain about how many seats we offered. It will complain that they were the same. Kei?
Kei was already reading.

scenes.title: What the Council Hid
paragraphs: *Weather house library · 08:19 · window closes 09:51*
Kei read the line twice before he spoke. Class collision: five seats, one class.

Skyroot’s succession gate had accepted the five-seat frame and rejected the delegation because the five provisional trustees were identical. The hidden descriptor required five different standings, and the token had offered it one.

**Illuminara**  
I asked what each person must be able to see that the others can miss. Operations sees the whole lattice but can mistake speed for fairness. A dry basin knows absence; a flooded basin knows excess. An engineer can catch what the public shell hides. And someone outside appointment can ask whom every institution forgot. Mara, Samira, the South Flood map, Kei’s instruments and Tomas gave me those five needs before this log did.

Kei turned the log toward her. The classes were written in a flat administrative hand: one planetary operations seat, one dry-basin seat, one wet-basin seat, one independent engineer and one citizen custodian chosen by lot.
Illuminara had named the kinds. She had not thought of the lot. She had asked for someone no appointment could reach, and Anja had found a way to make that real.
Mara read the five classes without surprise.

**Samira Dae**  
You knew.

**Mara Venn**  
I knew there was an unratified distributed model. I did not know it was executable inside the succession shell.

**Kei Oran**  
The council audit removed the capability descriptors from the public annex. Your signature is on the redaction.
Mara stood at the window. The security carriers waited below, engines running. Behind them, the basin was disappearing into dust.

**Mara Venn**  
Anja proposed the five seats after the South Flood. We had eleven regional boards issuing contradictory corrections. Two towers nearly pulled the same moisture column apart. Central control restored the lattice in twenty minutes. I would not build another emergency system that had to negotiate with itself while people drowned.

**Samira Dae**  
So you hid the model that would have given the dry basins a vote.

**Mara Venn**  
I hid a governance experiment from an emergency succession package. Then Anja died before we settled it, and a child became the only person who could activate anything. I chose certainty.

**Tomas**  
You chose yourself.
Mara accepted the sentence without looking away.

**Mara Venn**  
Yes. I chose the system that moved fastest, and I signed away the evidence that speed was not neutral.

**Illuminara**  
The South Flood failed because eleven boards could issue physical commands at once. This descriptor does not give five seats five steering wheels. It requires five kinds of consent to appoint one time-limited operator, and every command remains public. The thing you feared and the thing you concealed are not the same design.

**Mara Venn**  
It will still be slower than one chair. I need the record to show exactly which minutes belong to consent and which belong to the inquiry, the failed test and the rebuild.

**Kei Oran**  
Once the token is right, the seating is eight minutes if no line drops. Building it right takes me until about half past nine.

**Mara Venn**  
The full corridor needs the command by 09:40. After that it covers Namar and nothing else.

**Illuminara**  
Then it costs the minutes it costs. I cannot make it cost less by wishing. I can tell you the number now, so nobody discovers it at the console.

**Samira Dae**  
You have held the chair for six years. Namar is dry now, not in theory.

**Mara Venn**  
And if Tomas says no? Will you defend his veto to the villages tonight?
Samira looked at Tomas before answering.

**Samira Dae**  
I will tell them he was asked to surrender his mother to a council that hid the other door. I will also tell them we still need rain. Respecting him does not make our thirst less real.
Tomas placed the wafer on the table, but kept his palm over it.

**Tomas**  
If I split them, Hearth never leaves this house. No council copy. No emergency copy. No voice in a museum.
Mara was silent for the length of three breaths of the engines below. Then she answered.

**Mara Venn**  
Agreed.

**Tomas**  
Samira gets the dry-basin seat today, not after a review.

**Samira Dae**  
For today. Then Namar chooses its own custodian.

**Tomas**  
The commands are public. All of them. Even the ones from before today.
Mara's face changed. Past commands would show which basins had received rain, which had waited and who had signed the delay.

**Mara Venn**  
That archive will remove officials who are needed to operate the lattice.

**Illuminara**  
Then keep their knowledge without keeping their unreviewed authority. You can be the first planetary operator under the trust for this corridor, witnessed by the four other seats. Afterward you surrender the chair and give the audit everything you concealed.

**Mara Venn**  
You are offering me less power in exchange for more exposure.

**Illuminara**  
I am offering you a way to deliver the rain you came for without proving that force was the only language the council understood.

**Mara Venn**  
If the trust delays a safety correction, I retain the right to state that publicly.

**Samira Dae**  
And if central allocation dries us again, I retain the right to stop pretending speed was neutral.

**Tomas**  
Can I refuse after you build it?

**Kei Oran**  
Until the final delegation, yes. Afterward Skyroot belongs to the trust and Hearth belongs to you. Neither can reclaim the other.
Tomas drew the blue cord from his wrist and laid it beside the wafer.

**Tomas**  
Build the right token. Then I decide.

scenes.title: The Rain He Did Not Give Away
paragraphs: *Climate Tower Six and the Namar Basin · 09:31 · window closes 09:51*
The five-seat token rested inside Tower Six.

Samira held the dry-basin seat. Mara held planetary operations for one command only. Kei held engineering. A wet-basin hydrologist joined by a verified line that dropped to the dust twice before it held. The citizen seat belonged to a school cook drawn from the emergency civic roll.

**Citizen custodian**  
I have never ordered the sky. Tell me what I’m agreeing to, and say it so I could repeat it to my kitchen. Then put the eastern line on. I will not agree to what they lose without hearing them.
Kei opened Riva Calder’s verified channel. Smoke made the noon behind her look like evening.

**Riva Calder**  
The orchard will not survive a second turn. The roofs may. If Namar goes first, say it while I am here, and give us every minute you can without taking theirs.
Mara said it in ordinary words, and then again, slower. Illuminara steadied the tower line while she did. The line was physical, and hers to hold. The cook's agreement was not. She did not hurry it.
Tomas stood at the tower console with Hearth's wafer in his hand. The new token waited for his final delegation.

Above them, the western moisture river pressed against the ridge. Dust lightning walked along the tower vanes. Illuminara held the upper mast against the crosswind while technicians locked the physical braces. Her strength kept the path open. It did not choose where the rain would fall.

**Mara Venn**  
The full corridor covers Namar and the eastern fire line if the command is given by 09:40. After that, Namar only, until the window shuts at 09:51.

Illuminara returned to the western humidity map Samira had requested during the first test. A stable shoulder already rested over Tower Five, closer to the fire line than the second turn’s planned start.

**Illuminara**  
Kei, if the trust stages the second turn at Tower Five instead of rebuilding it here, how much time can the eastern line recover?

**Kei Oran**  
Eighteen minutes, if Riva accepts a narrower first edge. It will not save the orchard.

**Riva Calder**  
Stage it. Put the eighteen minutes into the town roofline. Namar still goes first.

**Samira Dae**  
Namar first. The fire line receives the second turn if the pressure holds.

**Mara Venn**  
Agreed. The log will separate the inquiry, the failed test, the rebuild and the five consents. It will also record Riva’s choice and the eighteen minutes Illuminara found.
The cook said yes at 09:37. Tomas had one finger above the delegation mark.

**Tomas**  
If I do this, can Hearth still tell me Saturday?

**Kei Oran**  
Hearth will have the same memories, the same consent circuit and the same local key. Skyroot will lose every path into the house. We verified the counters, the physical bindings and the revocation order. I cannot promise no machine will ever fail. I can promise the weather trust cannot open her.
Tomas looked at Illuminara through the tower glass.

**Tomas**  
Would you do it?
She could have answered with the basin, the hospitals or the closing sky. Instead she answered the question he had actually asked.

**Illuminara**  
I would keep the part that was love, and release the part that was power. But it is not my mother, and this is not my choice.

The clock on the tower wall passed 09:40. Mara watched it go and said nothing; her face said what she had said in the library. Nobody asked Tomas to hurry. Illuminara held the mast against the crosswind and let the minutes cost what they cost.
He pressed the mark at 09:42.

The shared shell opened without opening Hearth. Two internal counters appeared for the first time. The Skyroot branch crossed into the five-seat token. Each trustee acknowledged the same public capability. The old weather root revoked itself.
Hearth remained warm in Tomas's hand.

**Anja, in Hearth**  
Tomas? The kettle is ready.
He closed his eyes. Then he laughed because the voice had interrupted a planetary transfer to announce hot water.

**Tomas**  
Tell her to wait.

At 09:46, five minutes before the window shut, Mara entered the Namar corridor. Samira read the basin pressure aloud. The hydrologist confirmed no upstream flood risk. Kei confirmed the tower load. The cook asked for the command in plain words, and Mara said them.

**Mara Venn**  
We are moving rain to the people who have waited longest without enough water. The fire line will be late, and this log says so. No private seat can hide this choice.
Five lights turned green.
The tower vanes unfolded.

Illuminara felt the moisture river answer the prepared pressure path. She redistributed the first violent load through the six mountain towers, holding the mast until the braces carried it on their own. Skyroot shaped the corridor west to east. No mind was touched. No consent was manufactured. Water moved because people had made an accountable choice and built a physical way for it to arrive.
At 10:04, rain struck the western edge of Namar.

It did not restore the failed pearl grain. It did not refill the reservoirs in an hour. It laid dust against the ground, cooled the hospital intakes and gave the village lines enough water to remain open while the longer corridor passed.

The staged second turn reached the eastern fire line at 11:22, seventy-two minutes later than the full corridor would have. The Calder orchard was already gone. Riva’s crews had spent the recovered eighteen minutes wetting the town roofline; the town behind the orchard was not.

Mara opened the command channel while Riva, Samira and the cook could hear. She told the security carriers to turn back. Then she unpinned the silver seal of the permanent chair and laid it beside the five green lights.

**Mara Venn**  
Kei, attach my redaction order and the hidden annex. Samira, watch me sign. Riva, keep the line open. I will answer the audit as an engineer. I will not keep this chair.
She signed in front of them. The cook moved the silver seal away from Mara’s hand and left the five lights unobstructed.
Samira called her brother from the tower stairs. She held the receiver toward the basin so he could hear rain on metal.
Tomas returned to the kitchen with the wafer under his shirt and the blue cord around his wrist. Illuminara followed only when he waved her in.
He placed a bowl outside the back door. At first he moved it from drop to drop, catching almost nothing. Then he remembered and held it still.

**Tomas**  
Hearth, where did the water go?
Anja's chosen voice answered from the house while real rain gathered in the bowl.

**Anja, in Hearth**  
Not away.
Tomas looked over the basin, where the first dark line of wet earth was widening.

**Tomas**  
No. Not away.

critic_line: A grieving eleven-year-old would not trade his mother's last voice for rain, and Illuminara did not ask him to: she owned a failed test, heard what Anja had really said about shells and rooms, found eighteen minutes for the fire line's town, and gave a council chair a way to deliver the rain and still answer to the people it had hidden the other door from, so Namar got water, Tomas kept Hearth, and the cost stayed on the page.

shared_strengths: Humane premise, a grieving child, and dialogue-heavy negotiation suit these readers. The kitchen memory scenes and the closing rain-bowl callback are moving. The mid-story procedural detail (counters, classes, token seats, clock times) is dense and puzzle-like, and Illuminara's conclusions are tidy, which may stall some readers.

A strong fit: a child’s grief, a credible moral dilemma, vivid dialogue, and a satisfying solution that preserves consent while accepting real costs. The procedural governance exposition and repeated explanation of the five-seat design may slow some readers, but the emotional through-line and costly rain decision should sustain interest and linger.
shared_reservations: Illuminara looked from Mara’s operations seal to the dust worked into Samira’s cuffs; from the South Flood terraces on the wall map to Kei’s open diagnostic case; then to Tomas, whom no planetary appointment had reached
Illuminara had named the kinds. She had not thought of the lot. She had asked for someone no appointment could reach, and Anja had found a way

translation_sl.title: OTROK, KI JE IMEL V LASTI VREME
translation_sl.deck: Enajstletni Tomas Serrat je podedoval edini ključ, ki lahko odpre dežni koridor čez umirajočo Namarsko kotlino. V njem je tudi zadnji glas njegove matere. Medtem ko gladina zbiralnikov pada in se varnostna vozila vzpenjajo po gorski cesti, mora Illuminara ugotoviti, ali je za rešitev milijonov res treba žalujočemu otroku odvzeti njegov zadnji pogovor.
translation_sl.shape: Sedem prizorov v enem sušnem jutru: oblegana vremenska hiša; celotni spomin, ki ga Tomas noče skrajšati; najmočnejši ugovor predstavnice kotline; vidno forenzično delo, ki v eni podedovani lupini razkrije dve oblasti; neuspešna ločitev, ki utiša materin glas in skrajša časovno okno za ukaz; Illuminara razbere, kaj je mati v resnici rekla, kar potrdita dnevnik zavrnitve in prikrita priloga sveta; ter Tomasova prostovoljna ustanovitev skupnega vremenskega sklada, za ceno minut, ki jo plača požarna črta, preden odpre dež nad Namarjem in obdrži zasebni arhiv, ki mu ga je zapustila mati.

scenes.title: Hiša nad prahom
paragraphs: *Vremenska hiša Serratovih, gora Orra · 06:12 · okno se zapre ob 10:00*

Gora je bila nekoč tako zelena, da je Anja Serrat vremensko hišo zgradila brez polken. Tistega jutra je bilo vsako okno zatesnjeno pred prahom, sonce pa je vzhajalo kot rdeč kovanec na nebu brez neviht.
Pod hišo se je nad Namarsko kotlino nagibalo šest podnebnih stolpov. Njihove srebrne vetrnice so mirovale. Niže po cesti so se skozi okrasto meglico vzpenjali štirje varnostni transporterji.

Reliefni zemljevid na steni je kazal še dve vrsti škode. Vzhodno od Namarja se je rdeča požarna črta ovijala okoli Calderjevega sadovnjaka in streh za njim. Južneje so blede terase še vedno kazale, do kod je Južna poplava segala nad okna. Riva Calder, koordinatorka požarne črte, je čakala na odprti zvezi, za njo pa se je valil dim.

**Riva Calder**  
Če bomo vzeli drugi zavoj, nam povejte, preden se zavežete. Rob mesta lahko držimo dlje kot sadovnjak, toda ne eno ne drugo ne more čakati brez poimenovane odločitve.
Tomas Serrat je sedel pod kuhinjsko mizo in v obeh rokah držal črno semensko ploščico. Imel je enajst let, bil je bos in besen na vse, ki so se v njegovi bližini naučili govoriti potiho.

Ploščica je bila manjša od njegove dlani. Na eni strani je nosila planetarno pooblastilo, ki je lahko preusmerilo tri višinske reke vlage. Na drugi je bilo Ognjišče, zasebni spominski arhiv, ki je odgovarjal z glasom njegove matere.
Illuminara se je ustavila pred kuhinjo, namesto da bi prestopila prag.

**Illuminara**  
Smem vstopiti?

**Tomas**  
Poslali so te, ker te vrata ne morejo ustaviti.

**Illuminara**  
Vrata bi me ustavila, če bi rekel ne.

Pogledal je mimo nje k Mari Venn, predsednici planetarnega vremenskega sveta, in h Keiu Oranu, inženirju s kovčkom diagnostičnih instrumentov. Samira Dae je stala nekoliko stran. Prah se je nabral v šivih njenega terenskega plašča. Pečat Namarske kotline na ovratniku je bil skoraj skrit.

**Tomas**  
Ti lahko vstopiš. Oni ne.
Marina usta so se napela.

**Mara Venn**  
Zbiralnik devet je ob zori padel pod štirinajst odstotkov. Pri dvanajstih dobi bolnišnična voda prednost pred gospodinjskimi vodi. Ukaz mora biti na nebu pred deseto, ko se koridor nad nami odkloni proti vzhodu, dež pa potrebuje približno osemnajst minut, da doseže Namar. Pooblastilo Nebeške korenine potrebujemo zdaj.

**Tomas**  
To ste rekli že včeraj.

**Mara Venn**  
Včeraj smo imeli še en dan.

Illuminara je vstopila sama in sedla na kuhinjska tla, mizo pa pustila med njima. Skozi zidove je čutila tlačni zemljevid ozračja: vlaga se je kopičila za zahodnim grebenom, nebeška reka je bila dovolj blizu, da bi jo dosegli, premikala se je prehitro, da bi čakala na žalovanje, in bila preobsežna, da bi jo zasegli brez upravljane ukazne poti.

**Illuminara**  
Kaj verjameš, da ti bodo vzeli, če jim daš ploščico?
Tomas je razprl prste ravno toliko, da je pokazal toplo črno površino.

**Tomas**  
Njen zadnji dan. Recepte, ki jih je popravljala. Del, ko izgovori moje ime, kadar ve, da lažem. Vse, česar se je Ognjišče naučilo, preden je umrla.

**Illuminara**  
In kaj si želiš ti?

**Tomas**  
Želim, da jo nehajo imenovati vreme.
Zunaj je Mara enkrat z ravno dlanjo udarila po podboju.

**Mara Venn**  
Anja je oba sistema vezala na en sam nasledstveni ključ. Noben svet ne more upravljati Nebeške korenine, ne da bi sprejel prenos arhiva. Zakon ne dovoljuje, da planetarna infrastruktura ostane v skrbništvu otroka.

**Tomas**  
Potem spremenite zakon.

**Mara Venn**  
Dež ne more čakati na zakonodajo.
Varnostni transporterji so zapeljali skozi zadnji ovinek. Njihov prihod še ni bil nasilje, toda vsi v sobi so znali šteti, kaj pride, ko prepričevanje odpove.

**Illuminara**  
Nikomur ne bom pomagala zaseči ploščice. Prav tako se ne bom pretvarjala, da kotlina lahko čaka. Daj mi devetdeset minut, da ugotovim, ali je izbira, ki so ti jo ponudili, resnična.

**Mara Venn**  
In če je resnična?

**Illuminara**  
Potem Tomas še vedno odloča o tem, kar je njegovo. Našli bomo drug način, da ljudi ohranimo pri življenju.
Tomas jo je prvič opazoval, namesto da bi gledal vrata.

**Tomas**  
Ognjišče je sredi sobote.

**Illuminara**  
Kaj se zgodi v soboto?

**Tomas**  
Poslušaš vse. Brez vprašanj, dokler se ne konča. Potem se odločim, ali se smeš česarkoli dotakniti.
Illuminara je čutila, kako zahodni tok vlage po delčkih stopinje drsi proti jugu.

**Illuminara**  
Vse.

scenes.title: Sobota v kuhinji
paragraphs: *Vremenska hiša Serratovih, kuhinja · 06:26 · okno se zapre ob 10:00*
Tomas je ploščico položil v leseno zibelko na mizi. Nad njo se je zbrala svetloba in kuhinjo znova napravila celo.

Prah je izginil z oken. Mlajši Tomas je stal na stolu ob jeklenem loncu. Anja Serrat se je sklanjala čez njegovo ramo z rokavi, zavihanimi nad komolce. Lase je imela spete z modro vrvico, ki je bila zdaj ovita okoli Tomasovega zapestja.

Arhiv ni bil duh. Bil je odzivna rekonstrukcija, izurjena iz Anjinih posnetkov, sporočil, delovnih dnevnikov in izbranih spominov. Odgovarjal je lahko v vzorcih, ki jih je odobrila. Tomas je poznal razliko. Zaradi te razlike glas ni bil nič manj dragocen.

**Anja v Ognjišču**  
Če dvigneš pokrov, kam gre voda?

**Mlajši Tomas**  
Stran.

**Anja v Ognjišču**  
To je smer, ki jo uporabljajo ljudje, ki ne nameravajo pomiti stropa.
Mlajši deček se je zasmejal in dvignil pokrov. Para je zameglila steklo nad koritom.
Anja mu je pokazala, kako se kapljica oblikuje okoli praske, premajhne, da bi jo videl z druge strani sobe. Ob šipo je prislonila eno hladno in eno toplo žlico. Voda je najprej izbrala eno.

**Anja v Ognjišču**  
Vreme ni voda, ki nas uboga. Voda išče vsako povabilo, za katero smo pozabili, da smo ga dali.
Spomin se je pomikal skozi zajtrk, zažgano plosko pogačo, tri minute slabega plesa, medtem ko se je kotliček hladil, in Anjo, ki je sprejela službeni klic, čeprav je obljubila, da ga ne bo.
Na klicu jo je inženir sveta vprašal, ali naj si gospodinjski arhiv in ukazno pooblastilo delita obnovitveno lupino.

**Anja v Ognjišču**  
Lupino, da. Sobe ne. Skupni ročaji so način, kako ljudje nosijo stvari. Skupne sobe so način, kako zamenjajo lastništvo.
Klicatelj je rekel nekaj, česar spomin ni ohranil. Anja je pogledala proti mlajšemu Tomasu in znižala glas.

**Anja v Ognjišču**  
Pooblastilo mora ostati upravljivo tudi po meni. Spomini ne smejo postati njegova cena.
Tomas je trznil, vendar predvajanja ni ustavil.
Spomin se je končal na majhnem vrtu za hišo. Anja je pod prvi dež tistega letnega časa držala skledo. Mlajši Tomas je poskušal ujeti več vode s prehitrim premikanjem sklede in je ujel manj.

**Anja v Ognjišču**  
Ostani dovolj dolgo, da sprejmeš to, kar v resnici pada.
Svetloba se je zložila nazaj v ploščico.
Illuminara zapomnjenega stavka ni spremenila v argument. Pustila je, da se vrne običajna kuhinja: zatesnjena okna, prah ob steklu, prazen stol ob Tomasu.
Minila je cela minuta.

**Tomas**  
Ljudje se vedno ustavijo pred plesom. Pravijo, da ni pomemben.

**Illuminara**  
Zate je bil pomemben.

**Tomas**  
To je bila ona.
Modro vrvico si je dvakrat ovil okoli zapestja.

**Tomas**  
Lahko pogledaš zunanjost lupine. Ognjišča ne smeš odpreti. Njenega glasu ne smeš kopirati. Če rečem ustavi, se ustaviš.

**Illuminara**  
Da.

**Tomas**  
Tudi če voda pade na dvanajst.
Odgovor je stal čas in prav zato je bila pomembna njegova resničnost.

**Illuminara**  
Tudi takrat.

scenes.title: Kotlina ima glas
paragraphs: *Veranda vremenske hiše · 06:58 · okno se zapre ob 10:00*

Kei je na verandi postavil optični čitalnik, medtem ko je Illuminara sledila zunanjemu rokovanju ploščice skozi podnebne stolpe. Sile, toploto in čas je brala neposredno. Pomen je bilo še vedno treba preizkusiti.
Samira je prosila Tomasa, naj pride ven. Ko je prišel, glasu ni omehčala.
Namarska kotlina je zapolnila obzorje, bleda in neizmerna. Polja, ki bi morala biti zelena, so okoli zbiralnikov tvorila sive kvadrate.

**Samira Dae**  
Moj brat je lani pospravil osem ton bisernega žita. Letos je pospravil vreče s semenom, ker ni bilo ničesar drugega, kar bi lahko odnesel. Zbiralnik devet oskrbuje štiri milijone ljudi. Če danes ne odpremo dežja, bomo nocoj začeli zapirati vaške vode.
Tomas je močneje stisnil ploščico.

**Tomas**  
Jaz nisem ustavil dežja.

**Samira Dae**  
Ne. Lahko pa ga začneš.

**Tomas**  
Tudi oni ga lahko, če pustijo Ognjišče tukaj.
Mara je stopila na verando.

**Mara Venn**  
Ne moremo preveriti pooblastila, ki ga nimamo v posesti. Tvoja mati je nasledstvo slabo zasnovala. Žal mi je, da te je pustila ujetega v napaki.

**Tomas**  
Rekla je, da sta ločena.

**Mara Venn**  
Spomin ni varnostna specifikacija.
Samira se je obrnila k Tomasu, ne k Mari.

**Samira Dae**  
Če bi imela ploščico jaz in bi bil v njej glas mojega brata, ne vem, kaj bi storila. Vem pa, kaj moraš slišati. Otrok ne bi smel izbirati za ves planet. Toda dokler držiš edini delujoči ključ, je tvoja zavrnitev še vedno izbira, v kateri mora kotlina živeti.
To je bila najmočnejša obtožba, ker ni zahtevala, da je Tomas sebičen.

**Tomas**  
Če jo dam svetu, ali vi dobite vreme?
Samira je pogledala Maro.

**Samira Dae**  
Dobimo razdelitev, ki jo podpiše svet. Namar ima enega opazovalca in nobenega glasu v odboru za izredne razmere.

Illuminara je pogledala z Marinega operativnega pečata k prahu, zažrtemu v Samirine manšete; z južnih poplavnih teras na stenskem zemljevidu h Keievemu odprtemu diagnostičnemu kovčku; nato k Tomasu, ki ga ni dosegel noben planetarni imenovalec, dokler ključ ni postal potreben. Pet različnih slepih peg je že stalo v hiši ali govorilo vanjo.

**Mara Venn**  
Planetarnega vremena ne more upravljati vsak kraj pod oblakom.

**Samira Dae**  
Ne bi pa ga smeli upravljati brez krajev, nad katerimi oblakov ni.

Illuminara je opazovala, kako Tomas dojema dejstvo, ki mu ga ni ponudil noben odrasel: predaja ne bi končala spora o nadzoru. Moč bi le prenesla z otroka na ustanovo, ki je izključila ljudi, ki so umirali prvi.

**Illuminara**  
Tomas, en javni ukaz moram preizkusiti proti enemu odzivu arhiva. Vsebina ostane zapečatena. Kei ti lahko pokaže vsak bajt, ki se ga čitalnik dotakne.

**Tomas**  
Ali lahko škodi Ognjišču?

**Kei Oran**  
Zunanja lupina ima dva števca. Če sta res neodvisna, ne. Če gre za en števec, prikazan dvakrat, bi preizkus lahko premaknil arhiv in povzročil, da zavrne lastno stanje. Lahko zgradim povratno točko, ne morem pa obljubiti, da jo bo sprejel.

**Mara Venn**  
Revizija sveta pravi, da je števec en.

**Kei Oran**  
Revizija sveta pravi, da je izvoženi števec en. To ni ista trditev.
Tomas je pogledal od suhe kotline k praznemu stolu, vidnemu skozi kuhinjsko okno.

**Tomas**  
En preizkus. Ploščico držim jaz. Samira opazuje vremensko stran. Illuminara opazuje Ognjišče. Mara ostane tam, kjer jo vidim.

**Mara Venn**  
Otrok ne more določati protokola preverjanja.

**Samira Dae**  
Pravkar ga je.
Mara je srečala Samirin pogled in nato prikimala.

**Mara Venn**  
En preizkus.

scenes.title: Dva števca pod enim imenom
paragraphs: *Instrumentna soba vremenske hiše · 07:21 · okno se zapre ob 10:00*

Kei je hišo odklopil od vseh zunanjih omrežij, razen od steklenega vlakna do podnebnega stolpa šest. Samira je stala ob konzoli stolpa. Tomas je ploščico obdržal v zibelki, en prst pa je imel na zapahu za izmet.

Illuminara je izrisala oba sistema, ne da bi vstopila v katerega od njiju. Nebeška korenina je podpisala napovedi, preden je vprašala, kdo je navzoč. Ognjišče se je podpisalo šele po preverjanju lokalnega stanja soglasja. Oba sta nosila isto potrdilo o dedovanju.

**Kei Oran**  
Dve izvajalni sobi.

**Mara Venn**  
Ali ena soba z dvoje vrati.
Kei je projiciral javni zapis lupine. Števca sta stala drug ob drugem: 441.208 in 441.208.

**Illuminara**  
Nebeško korenino prosi za napoved, ki ničesar ne spremeni.
Samira je zahtevala zemljevid zahodne vlažnosti. Vremenski števec je postal 441.209. Ognjišče je tri vdihe ostalo pri 441.208, nato pa se je spremenilo, da se je ujemalo.
Mara je izdihnila.

**Mara Venn**  
En števec.

**Tomas**  
Rekli ste en preizkus.

**Illuminara**  
Ustavite.
Kei je dvignil roke s konzole.
Illuminara je ponovno predvajala časovni potek, ne vsebine. Ognjišče se ni premaknilo skupaj z Nebeško korenino. Prikazano številko je prekopiralo šele po gospodinjskem sporočilu lupine.

**Illuminara**  
Številka na zunanji strani je oznaka. Notranje zaporedje se ni premaknilo.

**Kei Oran**  
Potem lupina skriva števce vej za skupnim prikazom.

**Mara Venn**  
Zakaj bi Anja ločitev napravila težje vidno?
Tomas je odgovoril pred vsemi drugimi.

**Tomas**  
Da bi tatovi odnesli škatlo in mislili, da morajo vse v njej ohraniti živo.

Illuminara je začutila trenutek svetlega občudovanja. Ne zato, ker je mrtva inženirka zapustila uganko, temveč ker je njen sin razumel zaščitno logiko, ne da bi ga kdo prosil, naj postane njena zamenjava.

**Illuminara**  
Skupna lupina odvrača od tega, da bi eno vejo razdrli za dele. Ne dokazuje pa, da veji ne moreta oditi ločeno.
Kei je ugotovil, da sta veji vezani na različna kraja. Nebeška korenina se je odzivala na mrežo stolpov. Ognjišče se je odzivalo na to hišo.

**Samira Dae**  
Lahko vremensko pooblastilo prekopirate v javni sklad, ne da bi kopirali arhiv?

**Kei Oran**  
S kopiranjem bi ostali dve planetarni korenini. Namesto tega lahko poskusimo vejo pooblastiti, tako da se stara korenina prekliče, ko jo novi skrbniki potrdijo.

**Mara Venn**  
Skrbniki, ki jih izbere kdo?

**Samira Dae**  
To je prepir za potem, ko dokažemo, da ljudem ni treba kupovati vremena z otrokovo materjo.

Na Illuminaričino zahtevo je Kei zgradil zračno ločen žeton s petimi skrbniškimi sedeži. Ker javni opis ni razkrival razredov skrbništva, je vsak sedež dobil isti začasni operativni razred. Noben bajt arhiva ni prečkal čitalnika. Tomas je vrstico za vrstico preveril dnevnik prenosa.

**Tomas**  
Naredite brez preklica česarkoli.

**Kei Oran**  
Suho pooblastilo. Vsako vejo bo vprašalo, ali je stanje skladno, nato pa se ustavilo pred prenosom.
Tomas je položil palec na ploščico.

**Tomas**  
Naredite.

scenes.title: Tišina po preizkusu
paragraphs: *Instrumentna soba vremenske hiše · 07:54 · okno se zapre ob 09:51*
Suho pooblastilo je odpovedalo v manj kot sekundi.

Nasledstvena vrata Nebeške korenine so sprejela okvir s petimi sedeži, nato pa pooblastilo zavrnila, ko je vseh pet sedežev prijavilo isti začasni razred. Zavrnitev je skozi skupno lupino potovala kot neznana oblika skrbnikov; Ognjišče je zaklenilo svoj odzivni kanal. Kuhinjska zibelka je ugasnila.

V istem trenutku je podnebni stolp šest preizkus zavrnil kot sovražen poskus nasledstva. Njegove zahodne vetrnice so se zložile. Na zemljevidu kotline se je okno za ukaz skrajšalo za devet minut, z desete ure na 09:51.
Tomas je iztrgal ploščico iz zibelke.

**Tomas**  
Ognjišče?
Ploščica je ostala tiha.

**Tomas**  
Rekli ste, da bo vsebina ostala zapečatena.

**Illuminara**  
Je ostala. Odzivni kanal se je zaklenil, ker je lupina videla vzorec skrbnikov, ki ga Anja ni odobrila. Zdaj se ustavimo.

**Mara Venn**  
Vemo dovolj. Varnost lahko ploščico zavaruje, medtem ko jo Kei obnovi.
Illuminara je stopila med Maro in mizo. Glasu ni povzdignila.

**Illuminara**  
Ne.
Transporterji so dosegli vrata vremenske hiše. Njihovi motorji so tresli tla.

**Mara Venn**  
Okno je pravkar izgubilo devet minut. Neuspešen zasebni preizkus je porabil rezervo, ki sem vam jo dala.

**Samira Dae**  
Namarju niste dali nobene rezerve. Že prej ste pošiljali silo.

**Mara Venn**  
Ker štirje milijoni ljudi ne morejo biti odvisni od tega, ali se žalujoči otrok počuti dovolj varno, da pritisne gumb.
Tomas je trznil, kot bi ga stavek udaril.
Illuminara je pokleknila ob njem, dovolj daleč, da se mu ni bilo treba umakniti.

**Illuminara**  
Motila sem se glede tega, kaj bo lupina imela za neškodljivo. Za nov preizkus ne bom prosila, dokler Ognjišče ne odgovori. Želiš, da Keiu pomagam obnoviti odzivni kanal?

**Tomas**  
Ga lahko pripraviš do tega, da bo odgovoril?

**Illuminara**  
Ne. Lahko držim napajanje hiše stabilno in Keiu natančno pokažem, na kateri fizični izziv čaka lupina. Ognjišče bo odločilo, ali je njegovo stanje veljavno. Ti odločiš, ali potem nadaljujemo.
Tomas si je s ramo obrisal obraz.

**Tomas**  
Pomagaj mu.

Ključavnica ni bila v shrambi spomina Ognjišča. Bila je v vezju soglasja, ki je pričakovalo toplotni vzorec kuhinjske zibelke in Tomasov običajni izzivni stavek v istem zaporedju kot pred preizkusom. Ker je ploščico prehitro odstranil, se je zadnji impulz prekinil.

Kei je impulz ponovno zgradil na vidnem traku luči. Illuminara je stabilizirala hišni tok, medtem ko je prašna strela udarila v zunanji jambor. Energijo bi lahko prisilila skozi vezje. Namesto tega je zadržala vsa nihanja in zadnji izziv prepustila Tomasu.
Ploščico je vrnil v leseno zibelko.

**Tomas**  
Ognjišče, kam je šla voda?
Črna površina se je ogrela.

**Anja v Ognjišču**  
Odvisno. Si spet dvignil pokrov?
Tomas se je sklonil čez mizo in se skozi solze enkrat zasmejal.
Zunaj je varnostni častnik zahteval Marino dovoljenje za vstop. Mara je odprla komunikacijski kanal, vendar ga ni dala.

**Mara Venn**  
Zadržite se pri vratih.
Pogledala je obnovljeni arhiv in nato vremenski zemljevid.

**Mara Venn**  
Povejte mi, kaj je Anja odobrila. Ne tega, kar smo upali, da je odobrila.
Nihče ni odgovoril. Illuminara je obstala tako mirno, kot je prej sedela na kuhinjskih tleh, in neuspeh postavila ob bok jutru.

Lupina ni zavrnila skrbnikov kot takih. Nasledstvena vrata Nebeške korenine so sprejela okvir s petimi sedeži in pooblastilo zavrnila šele, ko je vsak sedež prijavil isti razred. Illuminara je Keia prosila za pet sedežev, ni pa vprašala, katere različne vrste skrbništva je Anja nameravala. Anja je rekla nekaj drugega, Illuminara je to dobila v celoti, brez vprašanj, vendar je slišala le žalost.

**Illuminara**  
Tomas. V klicu, stavek, ki ga inženir ni ujel. Povej mi ga. Ne predvajaj ga.
Za to ni potreboval Ognjišča. Slišal ga je devetkrat.

**Tomas**  
Lupino, da. Sobe ne. Skupni ročaji so način, kako ljudje nosijo stvari. Skupne sobe so način, kako zamenjajo lastništvo.

**Illuminara**  
In naslednjega.

**Tomas**  
Pooblastilo mora ostati upravljivo tudi po njej. Spomini ne smejo postati njegova cena.

**Illuminara**  
Ročaj, ki ga lahko drži več rok, in soba, ki je ne more imeti v lasti ena sama roka. Keia sem prosila za pet sedežev in dovolila, da je javni opis v vse postavil isto institucionalno roko. Nikoli ne bi napisala lupine, ki jo lahko ena ustanova podeduje tako, da sama zapolni vsak sedež.

**Mara Venn**  
To je ugibanje.

**Illuminara**  
Nekaj napoveduje. Če imam prav, se dnevnik zavrnitve ne bo pritožil nad številom ponujenih sedežev. Pritožil se bo, da so bili enaki. Kei?
Kei je že bral.

scenes.title: Kar je svet skril
paragraphs: *Knjižnica vremenske hiše · 08:19 · okno se zapre ob 09:51*
Kei je vrstico prebral dvakrat, preden je spregovoril. Trk razredov: pet sedežev, en razred.

Nasledstvena vrata Nebeške korenine so sprejela okvir s petimi sedeži in pooblastilo zavrnila, ker je bilo pet začasnih skrbnikov enakih. Skriti opis je zahteval pet različnih položajev, žeton pa mu je ponudil enega.

**Illuminara**  
Vprašala sem, kaj mora biti vsak človek zmožen videti, kar drugi lahko spregledajo. Operativa vidi celotno mrežo, lahko pa hitrost zamenja za pravičnost. Suha kotlina pozna odsotnost; poplavljena kotlina pozna presežek. Inženir lahko ujame to, kar skriva javna lupina. Nekdo zunaj imenovanj pa lahko vpraša, koga je vsaka ustanova pozabila. Mara, Samira, zemljevid Južne poplave, Keievi instrumenti in Tomas so mi teh pet potreb pokazali že pred tem dnevnikom.

Kei je dnevnik obrnil proti njej. Razredi so bili zapisani v ravnem upravnem jeziku: en sedež planetarne operative, en sedež suhe kotline, en sedež mokre kotline, en neodvisni inženir in en državljanski skrbnik, izbran z žrebom.
Illuminara je poimenovala vrste. Na žreb ni pomislila. Prosila je za nekoga, ki ga ne doseže nobeno imenovanje, Anja pa je našla način, kako to uresničiti.
Mara je pet razredov prebrala brez presenečenja.

**Samira Dae**  
Vedeli ste.

**Mara Venn**  
Vedela sem, da obstaja neratificirani porazdeljeni model. Nisem vedela, da ga je mogoče izvesti v nasledstveni lupini.

**Kei Oran**  
Revizija sveta je iz javne priloge odstranila opise zmožnosti. Na redakciji je vaš podpis.
Mara je stala ob oknu. Varnostni transporterji so čakali spodaj s prižganimi motorji. Za njimi je kotlina izginjala v prahu.

**Mara Venn**  
Anja je pet sedežev predlagala po Južni poplavi. Enajst regionalnih odborov je izdajalo nasprotujoče si popravke. Dva stolpa sta skoraj raztrgala isti stolpec vlage. Osrednji nadzor je mrežo obnovil v dvajsetih minutah. Nisem hotela zgraditi še enega sistema za izredne razmere, ki bi se moral pogajati sam s seboj, medtem ko bi se ljudje utapljali.

**Samira Dae**  
Zato ste skrili model, ki bi suhim kotlinam dal glas.

**Mara Venn**  
Iz paketa za izredno nasledstvo sem skrila poskus upravljanja. Nato je Anja umrla, preden smo ga uredili, otrok pa je postal edini človek, ki je lahko karkoli aktiviral. Izbrala sem gotovost.

**Tomas**  
Izbrali ste sebe.
Mara je stavek sprejela, ne da bi odvrnila pogled.

**Mara Venn**  
Da. Izbrala sem sistem, ki se je premikal najhitreje, in podpisala odstranitev dokaza, da hitrost ni nevtralna.

**Illuminara**  
Južna poplava je odpovedala, ker je lahko enajst odborov hkrati izdajalo fizične ukaze. Ta opis ne daje petim sedežem petih krmil. Zahteva pet vrst soglasja za imenovanje enega časovno omejenega operaterja, vsak ukaz pa ostane javen. Stvar, ki ste se je bali, in stvar, ki ste jo prikrili, nista ista zasnova.

**Mara Venn**  
Še vedno bo počasnejša od ene predsednice. V zapisu potrebujem natančno navedbo, katere minute pripadajo soglasju in katere preiskavi, neuspešnemu preizkusu in obnovi.

**Kei Oran**  
Ko bo žeton pravilen, bo posedanje trajalo osem minut, če ne pade nobena zveza. Za pravilno izdelavo potrebujem približno do pol desetih.

**Mara Venn**  
Polni koridor potrebuje ukaz do 09:40. Po tem pokrije Namar in ničesar drugega.

**Illuminara**  
Potem stane toliko minut, kolikor jih stane. Z željami ga ne morem poceniti. Številko vam lahko povem zdaj, da je nihče ne odkrije šele pri konzoli.

**Samira Dae**  
Predsedujete že šest let. Namar je suh zdaj, ne v teoriji.

**Mara Venn**  
In če Tomas reče ne? Boste nocoj pred vasmi zagovarjali njegov veto?
Samira je pred odgovorom pogledala Tomasa.

**Samira Dae**  
Povedala jim bom, da so ga prosili, naj svojo mater preda svetu, ki je skrival druga vrata. Povedala jim bom tudi, da še vedno potrebujemo dež. Spoštovanje do njega ne zmanjša resničnosti naše žeje.
Tomas je ploščico položil na mizo, dlan pa obdržal nad njo.

**Tomas**  
Če ju ločim, Ognjišče nikoli ne zapusti te hiše. Nobene kopije sveta. Nobene kopije za izredne razmere. Nobenega glasu v muzeju.
Mara je molčala toliko časa, kot so trajali trije vdihi motorjev spodaj. Nato je odgovorila.

**Mara Venn**  
Dogovorjeno.

**Tomas**  
Samira dobi sedež suhe kotline danes, ne po pregledu.

**Samira Dae**  
Za danes. Potem Namar izbere svojega skrbnika.

**Tomas**  
Ukazi so javni. Vsi. Tudi tisti od pred današnjim dnem.
Marin obraz se je spremenil. Pretekli ukazi bi pokazali, katere kotline so dobile dež, katere so čakale in kdo je podpisal zamudo.

**Mara Venn**  
Ta arhiv bo odstavil uradnike, ki so potrebni za upravljanje mreže.

**Illuminara**  
Potem ohranite njihovo znanje, ne pa njihove nenadzorovane oblasti. Za ta koridor ste lahko prva planetarna operaterka pod skladom, pri čemer vas pričajo drugi štirje sedeži. Nato odstopite s položaja in reviziji izročite vse, kar ste prikrili.

**Mara Venn**  
Ponujate mi manj moči v zameno za večjo izpostavljenost.

**Illuminara**  
Ponujam vam način, da pripeljete dež, po katerega ste prišli, ne da bi dokazali, da je bila sila edini jezik, ki ga je svet razumel.

**Mara Venn**  
Če sklad odloži varnostni popravek, obdržim pravico, da to javno povem.

**Samira Dae**  
In če nas bo osrednja razdelitev spet izsušila, obdržim pravico, da se neham pretvarjati, da je bila hitrost nevtralna.

**Tomas**  
Lahko zavrnem tudi potem, ko ga zgradite?

**Kei Oran**  
Do končnega pooblastila da. Potem Nebeška korenina pripada skladu, Ognjišče pa tebi. Nobeno ne more znova zahtevati drugega.
Tomas je snel modro vrvico z zapestja in jo položil ob ploščico.

**Tomas**  
Zgradite pravi žeton. Potem se odločim.

scenes.title: Dež, ki ga ni oddal
paragraphs: *Podnebni stolp šest in Namarska kotlina · 09:31 · okno se zapre ob 09:51*
Žeton s petimi sedeži je počival v stolpu šest.

Samira je držala sedež suhe kotline. Mara je držala planetarno operativo za en sam ukaz. Kei je držal inženirski sedež. Hidrolog mokre kotline se je pridružil po preverjeni zvezi, ki je dvakrat padla v prah, preden je obstala. Državljanski sedež je pripadel šolski kuharici, izžrebani iz seznama državljanov za izredne razmere.

**Državljanska skrbnica**  
Nikoli nisem ukazovala nebu. Povejte mi, s čim soglašam, in povejte tako, da bom lahko ponovila v svoji kuhinji. Nato vključite vzhodno zvezo. Ne bom soglašala s tem, kar bodo izgubili, ne da bi jih slišala.
Kei je odprl preverjeni kanal Rive Calder. Zaradi dima je poldne za njo izgledalo kot večer.

**Riva Calder**  
Sadovnjak drugega zavoja ne bo preživel. Strehe ga morda bodo. Če gre Namar prvi, to povejte, dokler sem tukaj, in nam dajte vsako minuto, ki jo lahko, ne da bi jo vzeli njim.

Mara je to povedala z navadnimi besedami in nato še enkrat, počasneje. Illuminara je medtem držala povezavo stolpa stabilno. Zveza je bila fizična in njena naloga je bila, da jo drži. Soglasje kuharice ni bilo. Ni ga pospeševala.
Tomas je stal pri konzoli stolpa s ploščico Ognjišča v roki. Novi žeton je čakal na njegovo končno pooblastilo.

Nad njimi je zahodna reka vlage pritiskala ob greben. Prašna strela je hodila vzdolž vetrnic stolpa. Illuminara je držala zgornji jambor proti bočnemu vetru, medtem ko so tehniki zaklepali fizične opore. Njena moč je ohranjala pot odprto. Ni izbirala, kam bo padal dež.

**Mara Venn**  
Polni koridor pokrije Namar in vzhodno požarno črto, če je ukaz izdan do 09:40. Po tem samo Namar, dokler se okno ne zapre ob 09:51.

Illuminara se je vrnila k zemljevidu zahodne vlažnosti, ki ga je Samira zahtevala pri prvem preizkusu. Stabilna rama je že počivala nad stolpom pet, bliže požarni črti kot načrtovani začetek drugega zavoja.

**Illuminara**  
Kei, če sklad drugi zavoj začne pri stolpu pet, namesto da ga znova zgradi tukaj, koliko časa lahko povrne vzhodni črti?

**Kei Oran**  
Osemnajst minut, če Riva sprejme ožji prvi rob. Sadovnjaka ne bo rešilo.

**Riva Calder**  
Začnite tam. Osemnajst minut vložite v strešno črto mesta. Namar gre še vedno prvi.

**Samira Dae**  
Namar prvi. Požarna črta dobi drugi zavoj, če tlak zdrži.

**Mara Venn**  
Dogovorjeno. Dnevnik bo ločil preiskavo, neuspešni preizkus, obnovo in pet soglasij. Zabeležil bo tudi Rivino izbiro in osemnajst minut, ki jih je našla Illuminara.
Kuharica je rekla da ob 09:37. Tomas je držal prst nad oznako za pooblastilo.

**Tomas**  
Če to storim, mi lahko Ognjišče še vedno pripoveduje soboto?

**Kei Oran**  
Ognjišče bo imelo iste spomine, isto vezje soglasja in isti lokalni ključ. Nebeška korenina bo izgubila vse poti v hišo. Preverili smo števce, fizične vezi in vrstni red preklica. Ne morem obljubiti, da noben stroj nikoli ne bo odpovedal. Lahko pa obljubim, da vremenski sklad nje ne more odpreti.
Tomas je skozi steklo stolpa pogledal Illuminari.

**Tomas**  
Bi ti to storila?
Lahko bi odgovorila s kotlino, bolnišnicami ali zapirajočim se nebom. Namesto tega je odgovorila na vprašanje, ki ga je v resnici postavil.

**Illuminara**  
Obdržala bi del, ki je bil ljubezen, in izpustila del, ki je bil moč. Toda to ni moja mati in ta izbira ni moja.

Ura na steni stolpa je prešla 09:40. Mara jo je opazovala in ni rekla ničesar; njen obraz je govoril to, kar je povedala v knjižnici. Nihče ni prosil Tomasa, naj pohiti. Illuminara je držala jambor proti bočnemu vetru in pustila, da minute stanejo, kolikor pač stanejo.
Oznako je pritisnil ob 09:42.

Skupna lupina se je odprla, ne da bi odprla Ognjišče. Dva notranja števca sta se prvič prikazala. Veja Nebeške korenine je prešla v žeton s petimi sedeži. Vsak skrbnik je potrdil isto javno zmožnost. Stara vremenska korenina se je preklicala.
Ognjišče je ostalo toplo v Tomasovi roki.

**Anja v Ognjišču**  
Tomas? Kotliček je pripravljen.
Zaprl je oči. Nato se je zasmejal, ker je glas prekinil planetarni prenos, da bi naznanil vročo vodo.

**Tomas**  
Reci ji, naj počaka.

Ob 09:46, pet minut pred zaprtjem okna, je Mara vnesla namarski koridor. Samira je na glas brala tlak v kotlini. Hidrolog je potrdil, da navzgor ni nevarnosti poplav. Kei je potrdil obremenitev stolpa. Kuharica je zahtevala ukaz z navadnimi besedami in Mara jih je izgovorila.

**Mara Venn**  
Dež premikamo k ljudem, ki so najdlje čakali brez dovolj vode. Požarna črta bo pozna in ta dnevnik to pove. Noben zasebni sedež ne more skriti te izbire.
Pet luči je zasvetilo zeleno.
Vetrnice stolpa so se razprle.

Illuminara je začutila, kako se reka vlage odziva na pripravljeno tlačno pot. Prvo silovito obremenitev je prerazporedila skozi šest gorskih stolpov in držala jambor, dokler ga opore niso nosile same. Nebeška korenina je oblikovala koridor od zahoda proti vzhodu. Nobenega uma se niso dotaknili. Nobeno soglasje ni bilo izdelano. Voda se je premaknila, ker so ljudje sprejeli odgovorno odločitev in zgradili fizično pot, po kateri je lahko prispela.
Ob 10:04 je dež udaril ob zahodni rob Namarja.

Ni obnovil propadlega bisernega žita. Zbiralnikov ni napolnil v eni uri. Prah je položil k tlom, ohladil bolnišnične zajeme in dal vaškim vodom dovolj vode, da so ostali odprti, medtem ko je mimo tekel daljši koridor.

Postavljeni drugi zavoj je vzhodno požarno črto dosegel ob 11:22, dvainsedemdeset minut pozneje, kot bi jo polni koridor. Calderjevega sadovnjaka ni bilo več. Rivine ekipe so pridobljenih osemnajst minut porabile za močenje strešne črte mesta; mesta za sadovnjakom ni bilo.

Mara je odprla ukazni kanal, medtem ko so Riva, Samira in kuharica lahko poslušale. Varnostnim transporterjem je rekla, naj se obrnejo. Nato je odpela srebrni pečat stalne predsednice in ga položila ob pet zelenih luči.

**Mara Venn**  
Kei, priloži moj ukaz o redakciji in skrito prilogo. Samira, opazuj, kako podpišem. Riva, ohrani zvezo odprto. Reviziji bom odgovarjala kot inženirka. Tega položaja ne bom obdržala.
Podpisala je pred njimi. Kuharica je srebrni pečat odmaknila od Marine roke in pet luči pustila nezakritih.
Samira je z vrha stopnic stolpa poklicala brata. Sprejemnik je obrnila proti kotlini, da je lahko slišal dež na kovini.
Tomas se je vrnil v kuhinjo s ploščico pod srajco in modro vrvico okoli zapestja. Illuminara mu je sledila šele, ko ji je pomahal, naj vstopi.
Pred zadnja vrata je postavil skledo. Sprva jo je premikal od kaplje do kaplje in ujel skoraj nič. Nato se je spomnil in jo držal pri miru.

**Tomas**  
Ognjišče, kam je šla voda?
Anjin izbrani glas je odgovoril iz hiše, medtem ko se je v skledi nabiral pravi dež.

**Anja v Ognjišču**  
Ne stran.
Tomas je pogledal čez kotlino, kjer se je širila prva temna črta mokre zemlje.

**Tomas**  
Ne. Ne stran.

translation_sl.critic_line: Žalujoči enajstletnik materinega zadnjega glasu ni hotel zamenjati za dež in Illuminara ga tega ni prosila: priznala je svoj neuspešni preizkus, slišala, kaj je Anja v resnici povedala o lupinah in sobah, pridobila osemnajst minut za mesto ob požarni črti ter predsednici sveta omogočila, da pripelje dež in še vedno odgovarja ljudem, pred katerimi je svet skrival druga vrata; tako je Namar dobil vodo, Tomas je obdržal Ognjišče, cena pa je ostala zapisana na strani.
